Use the weekend to recharge your Martian energy. Tuesday is your power day because Venus trines Mars, sparking romantic love. Wednesday is worst as Sun opposite Pluto threatens your career. Channel your fire element into a structured creative plan, avoid impulse. Follow for daily updates.
